name: Corning 3599 96 well
author: Ramona Optics
notes: Corning 96 well clear flat bottom polystyrene TC-treated microplate, individually wrapped, with lid, sterile. Dimensions from the Corning 'Microplate Dimensions 96/384/1536' sheet, row '96 well flat bottom' under 'Solid black, white, and clear polystyrene plates'. Units in meters. Well spacing (pitch) 9 mm. Plate footprint 127.76 x 85.48 x 14.22 mm per the Corning and Falcon Microplates Selection Guide (CLS-C-DL-MP-014REV9), which Corning states meets the ANSI/SBS footprint standard; the dimension sheet rounds this to 127.8 x 85.5 x 14.2 mm. A1 well center is 14.3 mm from the left edge (Corning 'A1 column offset') and 11.2 mm from the top edge ('A1 row offset'). Well top diameter 6.86 mm, bottom diameter 6.35 mm, depth 10.67 mm, flat bottom. Well bottom thickness 1.27 mm, well bottom area 0.3165 cm^2, flange/skirt height 6.096 mm. Total well volume 360 uL, working volume 75-200 uL. Corning publishes no per-catalog-number drawing for this part; the family dimension sheet is the controlling document. Use 'pitch' and origin reference to compute all well centers.
